changelog: Fix: the optional AI analyst model now actually loads after download
Under the hood: numpy and llama-cpp-python's other runtime deps (jinja2, diskcache, typing_extensions, markupsafe) are now bundled so `import llama_cpp` succeeds in the frozen build
CLI: `densa-deck analyst show` now reports llama-cpp-python import status alongside the model-file check
Size bump: installer ~50 MB, ZIP ~60 MB (numpy is ~50 MB on its own)
